about: This is fictional demo content for exploring portfolio layouts, CVs and AI features.
Sample projects and experience can be edited without affecting any real portfolio.

items.body: Use the editor to switch layouts, themes and portfolio/CV languages. Try section ordering, compatible renderers, custom sections, templates, import/export and PDF settings. The sections below demonstrate the complete registered library. Some links are labeled placeholders; contact forms open an email draft and newsletter links need your own provider.
items.title: Try the complete studio

items.body: The private AI assistant proposes edits for review and draft apply. Saving remains explicit. Public AI chat requires an owner opt-in and a published portfolio. Use test cards in the Stripe sandbox. Demo allowances are limited and real AI requests consume the configured provider budget.
